title: Relocatable records using supported __based pointer declarations and conversions
source_design: One source with two aligned byte arenas and global base pointers; a record type with ordinary fields, next-node based pointer and a based-pointer typedef.

Build a short offset-linked record list at nonzero aligned offsets; walk it through based-pointer parameters, arithmetic, indexing, member loads and based↔ordinary pointer casts, then relocate by changing the base pointer.
Include self/void/explicit-segment based declarations only if untouched original public syntax validates them normally; no patched options or injected scanner state. Keep rejected preflight probes.
A checksum main verifies logical record values and returns0 under untouched originals before freezing. /Z7 supplies real based type/symbol debug paths; no PCH or separate backend assignments.

public_path_evidence.reason: Existing semantic actions call the three based modifier helpers from accepted TOK_BASED grammar routes.
A based symbol representation sets scanner_flags0x800 and constructs its base expression through make_based_pointer_base.
Based casts/assignments invoke conversion and normalization under actual based shape attributes and scanner state.
/Z7 type writing can request materialize_based_symbol for the real referenced base.
build_based_text is reachable when a based declaration needs textual formatting; /Zg is deliberately not included in the proposed single compilation, so its reach is lower confidence.

caution: These are independently identified remaining application routines, not a reachability promise. Type-cast variants require(__segment) according to original C2209, and based(void) requires:> per C2214/2215. Validate public success paths first and omit unsupported combinations rather than force states. The same source may reach only a subset of these forms.
validation_plan: Validate actual untouched CL spelling/semantics, capture actual C1 transport and complete inputs/outputs; execute the original checksum if backend support succeeds.
Freeze one coherent source and raw frontend oracles before accepting functions; exact original masked/native frontiers and whole-function/ABI/graph/default/alias/flag-word checks.
Register one completed native phase, retain all27 old native phases and rejection checks, original compiler verification and timings.

current_remaining.caveat: Remaining outside identified CRT/imports includes application functions, unresolved support, shared data and padding; no claim all bytes are reachable application instructions.

exclusions: No qc flags, injected memory, unsupported compatibility gates or speculative CRT classification.
